name: Deadshot
description: A permanent mini game played with Shot Tokens. Tap targets to find keys and upgrade chests.

phases.name: Play
phases.description: Choose 1x or 5x. A 5x attempt costs 5 Shot Tokens. On a grid of 12 targets, pick targets one at a time until you hit 2 keys. An up arrow gives an upgrade point, and 2 upgrade points raise the chest quality for better rewards. A +1 target gives an extra reward and a Point Boost multiplies your chest. The attempt ends at 2 keys and you get random rewards based on the arrows and +1 targets you hit.

rewards.name: Shot Token
rewards.note: Daily login on the event page. Also given as personal rewards in Foundry, Tundra Arms League, Canyon Clash, Armament Competition, Officer Project, SVS, and King of Icefield.

tips: The chest reward lists are not shown on the wiki.
